title: Sarah the tomboy: foot-races, a dressing-room fight with Boonie, and gin
summary: Sarah races and boxes like the men, kicks trumpeter Marion 'Boonie' Hazle in Boston, and becomes his drinking friend.

story.theme_name: Singers and the musicians who accompanied them

blocks.x: We were at times, when we were maybe at the station or something, where we had to spend two hours waiting for a train or something, in a foot-race or whatever we were doing, playing ball or whatever, with Sarah... One side would come out, if not first, very close to first, in running or anything else. Or if it came to a thing where there was an argument or something, she'd ball up her fists and ready to box, just like anybody else!

There was a funny incident happened once, when one of the trumpet players that Sarah was going with. This was in Boston, a little later. We were between shows. And one of the guys came back... And this guy is Marian Hays; we called him Boonie... He says to Boonie, "Boonie, man, there's a pretty girl back there who just told me to come back here and see if you were in the dressing room. She wants you to come out there." He says, "Oh yeah? What's her name?" "She says her name is so-and-so-and-so" -- I don't remember what it was. But he said, "Okay, tell her I'll be out in a minute." So he's very proud about this, because all the guys...you know,
we're out on the road, and this one girl is coming to hit on him, you know. "Tell her I'll be out as soon as I put on my coat" or something.

And Sarah looked at him and said, "You go through that door and I'll kick your ass." So Boonie looked at her, rolled his eyes and "Shit," he just ignored her and put his coat on, started for the door. Sarah put her foot in his behind, and they turned around and they went at it in the dressing room! And Sarah boxed just like any man, you know.

It was just a joy to be around somebody like that in a band. Sarah and I later on became fast friends. We'd hang out in cities, we'd drink together. I think hanging around her is when I really got hooked on drinking gin. Sarah and I would hang out in all the places... She's just a beautiful person.
